column1: # The engine variables (GVars) that the scripts (src/game/Script) or the data (call Scrap.Set) set: name, tag, why.
# Tags: WORLD_SETTING (one value for the whole world that the server sets and the clients take: physics, rules, the
# level's limits), STATE (presentation a client must keep in step: replicate the value), EVENT (a one-shot), SIM (a
# value of the simulation on the server only), SERVER_ONLY (callbacks and bookkeeping of the server's scripts),
# CLIENT_ONLY (the client's view, sound, menus, input, video). netclass.py counts the rows without a tag.
